notes.title: Patch Notes | 17.06.2025

It's always massively appreciated. notes.title: Patch Notes | 29.04.2025
notes.content:
Snipers,

Patch 1.20 has been deployed and includes a number of fixes, including fixing a bug where the player could have no items in their loadout, an issue where medals were not always tracked correctly when completing a level on Authentic difficulty and rebalancing the damage over distance fall-off for a number of weapons.

The community has been essential in getting reports in quickly, so a huge thank you from the team. Please continue to get in touch as it helps massively in getting quick resolves implemented. See below for a full list of patch notes.

[b]Paid Content (included as part of the season pass)[/b]

notes.content:
[h3]Snipers assemble![/h3]

HQ can proudly confirm that Sniper Elite: Resistance is [b]available to play now on Steam[/b].

Focus your scope on the new launch trailer - available to watch [url=https://youtu.be/B2q8N2mKO0o]here[/url].

[previewyoutube=B2q8N2mKO0o;full][/previewyoutube]

As well as the [b]Standard Edition[/b], Sniper Elite: Resistance is also available in a [b]Deluxe Edition[/b], which will include additional Season Pass content. The game has been enhanced for the [b]PlayStation Pro 5[/b], offering snipers the chance to experience the game in [b]full 4K resolution[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159384/206de9ac07c6d31d73c3bdf8f130b67fd4a3b95d.jpg[/img]

This new standalone story runs in parallel to the events of Sniper Elite 5 and turns the attention towards the hidden war, far from the front lines, deep within the heart of occupied France.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159384/66eba80cd3bfa34c33f52e25fba3587984f5deee.jpg[/img]

[list]

Sniper Elite: Resistance is available now.

Game Pass Day One, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Windows PC and PC via Steam, Epic and PlayStation 4 & 5.

Yes. Play with friends to conquer even the most treacherous of mission objectives.

Yes, cross-play will be supported across all platforms for Sniper Elite: Resistance. You can also toggle it on and off as you wish.

France, 1944. Sniper Elite: Resistance tells a gripping new standalone story that runs parallel with Sniper Elite 5 and turns the attention towards the hidden war, far from the front lines, deep within the heart of occupied France.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159384/fbfa743f0e3b3796ff1c8bd39e77de28e1481fb6.png[/img]

In addition to the bonuses included with the [b]Standard Edition[/b], pre-ordering the [b]Deluxe Edition[/b] will also offer you the classic [b]M1911 Pistol[/b] and [b]two days early access to the game[/b].
